description: This file contains a class definition for AnnotateTypesWithSchema, which extends torch.fx.Transformer to add type annotations based on Python function signatures within FX graph transformations, particularly for torch.nn modules, functional calls, and attribute fetches.

classes.name: AnnotateTypesWithSchema
classes.description: A transformer class that annotates FX graph nodes with return types extracted from Python function signatures, focusing on specific modules and functional calls.

methods.name: call_function( self, target: Target, args: tuple[Argument, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to annotate function call nodes with inferred return types, especially for torch.nn.functional operations.

methods.name: call_module( self, target: Target, args: tuple[Argument, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to annotate module call nodes with inferred return types based on module forward method signatures.

methods.name: get_attr( self, target: torch.fx.node.Target, args: tuple[Argument, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to annotate attribute nodes with Python type information inferred from TorchScript types.

methods.name: Optional[Any] _extract_python_return_type(self, target: Target)
methods.description: Extracts Python function return annotations using inspect.signature, for a given callable target.
